findings.evidence: Lines 176–183 define `twoRank` with `@[expose]` and immediately characterize it with `@[simp] theorem twoRank_def`.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` from this definition and rely on the adjacent `@[simp] twoRank_def` lemma.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` makes the class-group `twoRank` body available to downstream consumers, encouraging proofs by unfolding even though `twoRank_def` is the supported API.

findings.evidence: Lines 86–93 contain the exposed definition followed immediately by `@[simp] theorem twoRank_def`.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]`; keep `twoRank` opaque and use `twoRank_def` for rewriting.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` likewise unnecessarily exposes the narrow-class-group `twoRank` wrapper despite its complete restatement lemma.

summary: The two rank wrappers unnecessarily expose their implementation despite providing characteristic `twoRank_def` lemmas.
